title: Evaluation of concatenated gate inputs
statement: Let $k$ be an AND or OR gate, let $l_1$ and $l_2$ be finite lists of natural-number indices, and let $vals$ be a finite list of Boolean values. The gate of kind $k$ with input list $l_1$ followed by $l_2$ evaluates to the result of applying conjunction or disjunction, according to $k$, to the evaluations of the gates of kind $k$ with input lists $l_1$ and $l_2$, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ is a gate kind other than NOT
$l_1$ and $l_2$ are lists of natural numbers
$vals$ is a list of Boolean values
